primary_source_title: Version Spaces: A Candidate Elimination Approach to Rule Learning, T. M. Mitchell, IJCAI 1977 pp. 305-310
implementation_scope: Finite explicit categorical attributes, positive/negative ground labeled examples, axis-aligned conjunctions with per-field wildcard, and distinct bottom hypothesis; bounded research oracle, not runtime
signature: (finite-list of nonempty categorical attribute domains, finite-list of (ground-instance,bool-label)) -> tagged {status,S,G,version_space}
law: V={h in H | all h(x_i)==label_i}; S=minimal elements of V and G=maximal elements under inclusion of extension sets; each h in V lies between some s in S and g in G. Distinct result for contradictory source labels and empty representable hypothesis class.
positive_examples: No observations: S={bottom}, G={all-wildcard}, V=whole H including bottom
One positive example makes exact observation minimal S, all-wildcard maximal G
Negative example excludes covering general hypotheses and may split G into incomparable members
Repeated positive/negative label on same instance yields explicit CONTRADICTORY-OBSERVATIONS
falsifiers: If S,G reconstruct even one inconsistent hypothesis, boundary law fails
If S,G omit any consistent hypothesis, completeness fails
If ordering or duplicate examples change V, rule-learning semantics fails
If negative-only training is treated as one false value instead of constraints, G antichain fails
If unrepresentable XOR diagonal is assigned a hypothesis by guess, fail
If D1 Boolean label is replaced by empty-list truthiness or inexact category, fail
relation_to_existing: D9 UNIFY and D10 LGG concern term substitutions; version-space learning retains ALL consistent hypotheses under both positive and negative observational evidence. D1-D9/D10 exact-name negative is not proof of independent Core law: implementable as existing set/filter/order combinators, owner may classify derived library only.
backend_runtime_oracle: Python exhaustive finite research model; SENS native execution NOT ATTESTED
limitations: No noisy labels, continuous attributes, predicate terms, higher-order induction, unbounded machine learning, or admission to physical SENS
first_review_question: Is retaining maximal S/G boundary representation a separately language-visible law or a fully derivable library combinator in the current D1-D9/D10 algebra?
